gate_coverage.planner: active lifecycle plus current lifecycle service and ComputePathToPose action inventory required
gate_coverage.controller: active lifecycle plus current lifecycle service and FollowPath action inventory required without action invocation
gate_coverage.current_pose: stamp, callback receipt, map frame, covariance, run window, and natural-final freshness required
gate_coverage.persisted_pose: source, timestamp, canonical map identity, pre/post ordering, at-most-once initialpose, and live consumption required
gate_coverage.dynamic_tf: dynamic fresh map-to-odom uniquely attributed to AMCL plus dynamic odom-to-base receipt in the same natural-final window required
gate_coverage.planner_only_path: fixed task, route and goal plus exact ComputePathToPose result, non-empty map-frame path, fresh result receipt, and fresh path header required
gate_coverage.obstacle_clear: same current scan identity, exactly one publisher, finite points, natural-final freshness, and minimum distance at least 0.45m required
